title: BOC foreign-exchange board (USD row)
verbatim_or_extract: Pub Time 2026/11/11 10:40:02; USD per 100: Buying 666.31, Cash Buying 666.31, Selling 669.12, Cash Selling 669.12, Middle 671.91.
supports: Live CNY/USD bid, ask and cash selling rates; board timestamp.

title: Personal e-banking cross-border wire tariff
verbatim_or_extract: 跨境汇款（电汇）: 1‰ of the remittance amount, minimum RMB 50/tx, maximum RMB 260/tx; cable fee RMB 150/tx outside HK/Macao/Taiwan. Note 1 permits agreed, promotional and local differences.
supports: Published wire fee, cap, floor and cable charge.

title: 2026-11-11 ATM fee revision
verbatim_or_extract: Effective 2026-11-11: overseas UnionPay ATM withdrawal RMB 12 + 1%, maximum RMB 112/tx; Mastercard/VISA 2.5%, minimum USD 3/tx, maximum USD 40/tx.
supports: Published BOC ATM card fees; not an FX conversion rate.

title: 2014 personal full-amount (全额到账) surcharge notice
verbatim_or_extract: From 2015-04-01, in addition to wire fee and cable: USD full-amount service USD 15/tx when the receiving bank holds an account at BOC New York, otherwise USD 25/tx; applies where an intermediary bank is required.
supports: Historical OUR surcharge; current 2026 applicability is flagged, not assumed.

title: Outbound foreign-currency remittance service
verbatim_or_extract: Wire form needs currency/amount, payee name/address, account number, bank name and SWIFT code or address; intermediary banks may deduct a transfer fee from the principal.
supports: Execution details and the official reason receiving/intermediary fees are left blank.

title: 经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）, 汇发〔2020〕14号 (full text)
verbatim_or_extract: Arts. 54-57, 59-67, 86 and 89 read: USD 50,000 convenience amount; Art. 59 foreign individual documented RMB income; Art. 60 24-month reconversion; Art. 62 watch-list; Art. 64 outward wire; Art. 65 FX-account wire; Art. 67 own-account/relative transfers; Arts. 86/89 cash limits.
supports: Primary PRC current-account FX rules.

title: 2026 personal FX Q&A No. 08 — Art. 59
verbatim_or_extract: 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇.
supports: Documented-income route for a foreign passport holder.

title: 2024 current-account FX case Q&A No. 09
verbatim_or_extract: Art. 59; 持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度.
supports: Only PRC Foreign Permanent Resident ID holders get the purchase convenience amount.

title: 2022 FX policy Q&A No. 08
verbatim_or_extract: 每人每年等值5万美元; 年度便利化额度不是…限额，只是超过等值5万美元的购汇或结汇不能仅凭本人有效身份证件办理.
supports: USD 50,000 is a documentation threshold, not a hard cap.

title: 2024 personal FX Q&A No. 03 — Art. 64
verbatim_or_extract: 境内个人外汇账户内外汇汇出境外当日累计等值5万美元以下（含）的，凭本人有效身份证件办理；超过上述金额的，凭本人有效身份证件、有交易额的相关材料办理.
supports: Domestic-individual outward-wire documentation threshold.

title: 2026 personal FX Q&A No. 10 — Art. 60
verbatim_or_extract: 原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理；原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；当日累计不超过等值500美元（含）…可凭本人有效身份证件办理.
supports: 24-month exchange-slip reconversion and small ID-only amounts.

title: 2025 personal FX Q&A No. 08 — watch-list
verbatim_or_extract: 借用他人便利化额度及其他方式规避便利化额度及真实性管理的个人，列入“关注名单”…关注期限为列入当年及之后连续2年.
supports: Anti-smurfing watch-list current year plus two calendar years.

title: 2021 service-trade FX Q&A No. 04
verbatim_or_extract: 境外个人从境内取得的服务贸易、收益和经常转移项下人民币收入购汇汇出，可凭身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理.
supports: Tax voucher forms for service income and current transfers.

title: PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16 — individual property transfer
verbatim_or_extract: Defines 移民转移 and 继承转移; Arts. 8-9 list inheritance/property/tax documents; Art. 11 remits directly to the applicant's own overseas account.
supports: Emigrant and inheritance approval routes.

title: 汇发〔2014〕2号 capital-account reforms
verbatim_or_extract: §6: approval at former/decedent hukou; bank may remit once or in instalments within the approved amount; RMB 500,000 HQ reporting and staged-remittance requirement removed; property notarisation removed. §5: profit distribution above USD 50,000 needs resolution and tax filing form.
supports: Approval routes and dividend documentation.

title: 2026 personal property transfer Q&A No. 07
verbatim_or_extract: 汇发〔2024〕12号 6.4: 移民财产转移由移民原户籍所在地外汇局负责审批；继承财产转移由被继承人生前户籍所在地外汇局负责审批.
supports: Which SAFE office approves each transfer.

title: 2025 operating guide to 汇发〔2025〕43号, §8 (PDF)
verbatim_or_extract: 境外个人转让境内商品房所得资金购汇汇出: passport, registered transfer contract and title-transfer proof, tax voucher; tax filing form waived at ≤USD 50,000; remittance capped at transfer price minus taxes/fees.
supports: Property-sale document list and tax voucher.

title: Announcement 2013 No. 40 (as amended 2021 No. 19)
verbatim_or_extract: Art. 1: single outbound payment above USD 50,000 for salary, dividends, real-estate transfer income etc. requires tax record-filing (税务备案). Art. 4: foreign individuals follow personal FX rules.
supports: USD 50,000 tax-recordal threshold.

title: Foreign Exchange Regulation, Decree No. 532
verbatim_or_extract: Art. 5 no restriction on current-account payments/transfers; Art. 12 genuine lawful basis; Arts. 39/40/45 fines up to 30%, 30%-100% if serious; Art. 42 border cash up to 20%; Art. 48 untrue documents up to RMB 50,000 for individuals; Art. 52(2) one-year residence definition.
supports: Core lawful basis and PRC penalties.

title: 个人外汇管理办法, PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3
verbatim_or_extract: Art. 13 foreign individual lawful current-account RMB income may be converted/remitted at a bank; Art. 14 unused inbound FX may be returned; Art. 28 bank sets account category from the ID used to open the account.
supports: Account classification and no-conversion FX return.

title: 汇发〔2017〕29号 overseas bank-card cash withdrawals
verbatim_or_extract: RMB 10,000 per card per day; RMB 100,000 per person per calendar year; exceeding the yearly cap suspends overseas cash withdrawals for the current and following year.
supports: ATM/card withdrawal caps.

title: Carrying foreign-currency cash out of China
verbatim_or_extract: ≤USD 5,000 customs release; USD 5,000-10,000 bank carrying permit; above USD 10,000 SAFE permit in principle not granted.
supports: Cash-border limits.

title: Warning on online/private FX exchange
verbatim_or_extract: Only qualified banks, licensed exchange institutions and authorised agencies may handle personal FX; apps, WeChat swaps, FX brokers and underground banks are illegal; splitting and false documents are prohibited.
supports: Prohibited private channels.

title: 朱某 individual split-purchase penalty case
verbatim_or_extract: 52 people used to purchase/remit USD 2.5625 million; treated as 逃汇 under Decree 532 Art. 39 and fined.
supports: Real enforcement against quota splitting.

title: 银发〔2026〕42号 virtual-currency risk notice
verbatim_or_extract: Virtual-currency business is illegal financial activity; fiat/virtual-currency exchange, unapproved RMB stablecoins and RWA tokenisation are strictly prohibited; repeals 银发〔2021〕237号.
supports: No lawful CNY→USDT→USD route.

title: Cross-border RMB policy benefits (2018 article, live mirror)
verbatim_or_extract: 银发〔2018〕3号 supports individuals' other current-account RMB cross-border settlement; a foreign employee in Beijing remitted RMB salary directly to South Africa instead of first buying FX, saving the conversion charge.
supports: Live replacement for the inherited dead PBOC Beijing URL; personal cross-border RMB example.

title: 2018 monetary-policy chronicle: 银发〔2018〕3号
verbatim_or_extract: 1月5日: PBOC issued 银发〔2018〕3号; any cross-border transaction that may lawfully be settled in FX may be settled in RMB.
supports: Official existence and scope of the 2018 RMB policy.

title: PRC Individual Income Tax Law (2018)
verbatim_or_extract: Art. 3: comprehensive income 3%-45%; business income 5%-35%; interest, dividends, rent, property transfer and incidental income 20%. Art. 6(5): property gain = proceeds less original value and reasonable expenses.
supports: PRC tax rates on underlying income, not on conversion.

title: 财税〔2008〕132号 savings-interest exemption
verbatim_or_extract: 自2008年10月9日起，对储蓄存款利息所得暂免征收个人所得税.
supports: RMB savings-deposit interest IIT exemption.

title: PRC Tax Collection Administration Law (2015 text)
verbatim_or_extract: Art. 32: daily late-payment surcharge 万分之五 (0.05%). Art. 63: tax evasion penalty 50%-500% of underpaid tax; criminal liability if a crime.
supports: PRC tax late-payment and evasion penalties.

title: STA Announcement 2019 No. 35 — treaty benefits
verbatim_or_extract: 非居民纳税人享受协定待遇采取“自行判断、申报享受、相关资料留存备查”; Art. 7 requires tax-residency certificate, contracts/payment vouchers and beneficial-owner evidence where relevant.
supports: Treaty-rate self-assessment and retained documents.

title: U.S.–China Income Tax Convention (1984, PDF)
verbatim_or_extract: Art. 9(2) dividends may be taxed in the source state up to 10% of gross if the recipient is the beneficial owner; Art. 10(2) interest 10%; Art. 22(2) U.S. credit for Chinese income tax; Protocol 1 ¶2 saving clause: the United States may tax its citizens.
supports: Treaty rates, foreign tax credit and saving clause.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 988 (2023 ed.)
verbatim_or_extract: (a)(1)(A) ordinary FX gain/loss; (c)(1)(C) disposition of nonfunctional currency including bank deposits; (e)(2) no gain on a personal transaction unless it exceeds $200; (e)(3) §162/§212 expenses exclude personal treatment.
supports: U.S. currency-gain character and personal-transaction exclusion.

title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
verbatim_or_extract: CNY per USD: 2025 7.129; 2024 7.189; 2023 7.075; 2022 6.730; 2021 6.452. 'The Internal Revenue Service has no official exchange rate.'
supports: Historical yearly rates used only as labelled scenarios, not as an official spot rate.

title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
verbatim_or_extract: Form 8938 thresholds: single in U.S. $50,000 year-end / $75,000 any time; single abroad $200,000 / $300,000; joint filers double. Penalty up to $10,000, plus $10,000 per 30 days after notice, maximum $60,000.
supports: FATCA Form 8938 thresholds and penalty.

title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
verbatim_or_extract: A U.S. person must file an FBAR if aggregate foreign account value exceeds $10,000 at any time during the calendar year; due April 15 with automatic extension to October 15.
supports: FBAR filing threshold and due date.

title: 31 U.S.C. § 5321 (2023 ed.)
verbatim_or_extract: (a)(5)(B)(i) non-willful FBAR penalty ≤$10,000; (a)(5)(C)(i) willful penalty greater of $100,000 or 50% of the account balance; reasonable-cause exception for non-willful violations.
supports: Statutory FBAR penalty ceiling, now independently verified.

title: 31 CFR 1010.821 penalty adjustment table
verbatim_or_extract: Penalties assessed on/after 2025-01-17: non-willful FBAR $16,536; willful FBAR $165,353.
supports: Current inflation-adjusted FBAR penalty amounts.

title: 26 U.S.C. § 6039F (2021 ed.)
verbatim_or_extract: (c)(1)(B): 5% of the foreign gift for each month the failure continues, not to exceed 25% in aggregate; reasonable-cause exception in (c)(2).
supports: Form 3520 late/incomplete filing penalty.

title: Gifts from foreign persons
verbatim_or_extract: Form 3520 Part IV reports gifts/bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate exceeding $100,000 in the taxable year; foreign corporation/partnership gifts use the §6039F inflation-adjusted threshold.
supports: Foreign gift/bequest reporting threshold.

title: Foreign Tax Credit
verbatim_or_extract: The foreign tax credit offsets foreign income tax paid or accrued, subject to limitations; Form 1116 is generally used by individuals.
supports: Crediting PRC income tax against U.S. tax on the same income.

title: Streamlined Filing Compliance Procedures
verbatim_or_extract: Procedures for non-willful past noncompliance; links to U.S.-resident and foreign-resident instructions, delinquent international information return procedures, and IRS Criminal Investigation voluntary disclosure.
supports: Choosing a U.S. correction path.

title: Streamlined Domestic Offshore Procedures (SDOP)
verbatim_or_extract: 3 years of amended returns, 6 years of delinquent FBARs, and a Title 26 miscellaneous offshore penalty equal to 5% of the highest aggregate foreign asset balance/value.
supports: SDOP 5% penalty and filing scope.

title: Streamlined Foreign Offshore Procedures (SFOP)
verbatim_or_extract: 3 years of delinquent/amended returns and 6 years of delinquent FBARs; compliant eligible taxpayers are not subject to failure-to-file, failure-to-pay, accuracy, information-return or FBAR penalties.
supports: SFOP no-penalty framework and non-residency test.

title: Delinquent international information return procedures
verbatim_or_extract: Taxpayers not under examination/investigation and not contacted by IRS should file delinquent international information returns through normal procedures, attaching a reasonable-cause statement where asserted.
supports: Delinquent Form 8938/3520 etc. correction path.

title: IRM 4.26.16 — FBAR and delinquent FBAR procedures
verbatim_or_extract: IRM 4.26.16.3.11: delinquent FBARs use the current electronic report and year-specific instructions; a penalty is not asserted where the failure was non-willful, due to reasonable cause and properly reported on the delinquent FBAR.
supports: Live IRS delinquent-FBAR procedure replacing the tested 404 URL.

title: U.S. citizens and resident aliens abroad
verbatim_or_extract: U.S. citizens and resident aliens are taxed on worldwide income; foreign accounts above the reporting threshold require FinCEN Form 114 even if they generate no taxable income; Form 3520 reports foreign gifts/bequests over $100,000.
supports: Worldwide-income, FBAR and Form 3520 overview.

title: Foreign earned income exclusion
verbatim_or_extract: FEIE applies to foreign earned income from personal services; the page lists $107,600 (2020), $108,700 (2021), $112,000 (2022) and $120,000 (2023). Pension, annuity and investment/currency gains are not foreign earned income.
supports: FEIE does not shelter existing savings or currency gain; 2026 figure is flagged.

title: Money and monetary instruments
verbatim_or_extract: Currency or monetary instruments exceeding $10,000 entering/leaving the U.S. must be reported on FinCEN Form 105; the threshold applies collectively to a family or group.
supports: U.S. cash declaration rule.

title: 汇发〔2017〕15号 bank-card overseas transaction reporting
verbatim_or_extract: From 2017-09-01 domestic issuers report all overseas cash withdrawals and single purchases above RMB 1,000; the policy does not change personal FX rules and adds no personal filing cost.
supports: Card transactions are reported by the bank, not by the individual.
